# AB Digital Solutions

> Sydney web design and digital growth studio creating premium, fast and search-ready websites for ambitious Australian businesses.

## Key Facts

- Primary Services: Custom Web Design, Next.js Development, Technical SEO, Brand Strategy, E-commerce Solutions, Digital Marketing & Website Maintenance.
- Location: Sydney, NSW, Australia.
- Service Area: Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide, Perth, and Australia-wide.
- Tech Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vanilla CSS, Vercel Edge.
- Typical Pricing: $1,500 – $6,000+ AUD depending on scope and business requirements.
- Proven Portfolio: 7 live commercial client websites across logistics, property, removalists, equipment hire, and local services.

## Main Services & Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.abwebstudio.com.au/): Services, selected client work, studio process, principles, and contact form.
- [Web Design Sydney](https://www.abwebstudio.com.au/services/web-design-sydney): Custom website design and Next.js development for Sydney businesses.
- [SEO & Local Visibility](https://www.abwebstudio.com.au/services/seo-local-visibility): Technical SEO, local search optimization, and search architecture.
- [E-commerce Solutions](https://www.abwebstudio.com.au/services/ecommerce-website-development): Mobile-first storefronts, catalog management, and checkout integration.
- [Branding & Website Content](https://www.abwebstudio.com.au/services/branding-content): Visual direction, brand positioning, and website copy.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.abwebstudio.com.au/services/digital-marketing): Landing page design, lead generation, and campaign strategy.
- [Website Maintenance & Support](https://www.abwebstudio.com.au/services/website-maintenance): Ongoing support, technical health checks, and performance updates.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.abwebstudio.com.au/privacy): Information handling and privacy guidelines under Australian law.
